question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Companion
solution:
The correct answer is: **Mate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Companion"** means a person or animal with whom one spends a lot of time or with whom one travels. (साथी)
 
 
• **Example: **During his travels, he found a loyal companion in his dog.
 
 
• The word **"Mate"** refers to a friend, partner, or someone with whom you share a bond or close relationship. (मित्र)
 
 
• **Example: **He and his mate have been best friends since childhood.
 
 
• Thus, "mate" and "companion" are synonyms as both refer to someone who shares a bond or association with you.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Mate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Enemy** (दुश्मन): A person who is actively opposed or hostile to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** The two nations have been enemies for decades.
 
 
• **Neighbour** (पड़ोसी): A person living next door or very near to another.
 
 
• **Example:** Our neighbour is very friendly and often helps us with small tasks.
 
 
• **Sister** (बहन): A female sibling or someone who shares a sisterly bond.
 
 
• **Example:** My sister and I often go shopping together on weekends.
 

Question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. **Companion**

Correct answer: **Mate**
